title: 3D Maze Control
description: 3D Maze Control is a casual and fun puzzle physics game. Your goal is to rotate the board to let the ball reach its goal. The ball always falls down due to gravity and beware of scary aliens on the way.

title: Bubble Piggies
description: Bubbles Piggies is an engaging bubble shooter game with 50 levels. Free all piggies to complete the levels. When there are no piggies left in the tube the level will drop down 1 floor. Each level will face challenging features like the sleeping piggy, the hidden piggy, the powerup bubble, the moving bubble and more.

title: Bus Jam
description: Welcome to the thrilling world of "Bus Jam: Clear the Bus Stop," presented by Golden Guns Studio, a color sort puzzle, fun-packed game where your task is to skillfully bus match 3d passengers onboard onto buses of the same color. Imagine a busy Bus Jam stop with vibrant buses and puzzled passengers eager to board. Your mission? Ensure each person finds their way to the right bus, and brace yourself as the color puzzle master.

title: Perfect Asmr Cleaning
description: Immerse yourself in home cleaning and personal care with Perfect ASMR Cleaning! This is a casual cleaning simulator game where you can experience the whole process of cleaning work, such as washing carpets and trimming cat nails. Finish each task with full patience and enjoy the perfect sound of teeth polishing, cutting, and trimming.

title: Race Time
description:
Race through thrilling tracks in your speedy car! Collect gears to charge up your booster and unleash a powerful speed burst.
Upgrade your car to unlock better performance and purchase the fastest vehicles to dominate the competition.
Use the super boost to knock opponents off the track, climb the leaderboard, and prove you're the ultimate racer.
Beat the clock and challenge your friends online!

title: Mahjong Online
description: Mahjong Online is the classic version of the ancient board game that requires you to clear the board by matching the same patterned tiles. The rules dictate that there must be two or more of the same tiles to clear tiles from the play area and successfully win the game.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Interstellar
description: One of the most popular modern web proxies with blazing fast speeds and a variety of games.
genre: Unblocked, WebGame, Github.io, Discord, Games, Browser Game

title: DOP: Draw One Part
description:
► Can you see what’s missing? 

What a pretty picture, but don’t you get the nagging feeling that something’s not quite right? What’s the final touch that will make the image complete? 

Engage your brain, your imagination and your artistic talents to identify the missing element and add it to the drawing in this delightful puzzle game that will get you thinking and make you smile time and time again.

title: Underwater Survival
description:
Dive Into a Mysterious and Beautiful Underwater World
Welcome to an unforgettable underwater survival adventure where exploration, discovery, and survival come together in a stunning ocean environment. Dive deep into a vibrant and mysterious sea filled with hidden secrets, breathtaking visuals, and endless possibilities.

title: Garden Block Puzzle
description: A neglected garden, overrun by weeds and dried flowers… it can't stay like this! Test your wits, place the bricks strategically, complete each level and bring your garden back to life. Have fun playing and create the perfect space to relax.

title: Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem
description:
Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem is an exciting motorcycle racing game. 
In this game you will become a motorcycle racer who travels through city streets and highways, avoiding collisions with other vehicles. You will be able to unlock faster and more powerful motorcycles, each with its own unique handling characteristics, as well as improve the characteristics of your motorcycle. One of the key features of the game is a realistic physics engine that makes the gameplay challenging and exciting.

title: High Heel Design
description: Imagine you are a fashion shoemaker who produces the best high heels ever. In High Heel Design, you are in charge of fashion shoe design. Yes, what you produce is not sneakers, sandals, or boots, but high heels only! Unleash your creativity and combine elements to realize your own stunning high heels in this shoe-designing game.

title: Moto Road Rash 3D 2
description: Rev up your engines and feel the thrill of the open road in Moto Road rash 3D 2! This high-octane motorcycle game immerses you in a heart-pounding racing experience where agility and precision are your best allies. Zoom through a dynamic, ever-changing cityscape, weaving between lanes, dodging traffic, and mastering daring stunts.

title: Squad Assembler
description:
Assemble a cool squad and see who wins!
Combine items to improve the fighters' equipment! Combine weapons and armor, buy loot boxes with new weapons!
You can create cool, unique characters, each of which will have certain skills! Buy parts for your fighters, change their arms, torso, head! Create real cyborgs to defeat the enemy! Merge armor and weapons, increase the levels and characteristics of items. Hire cool heroes who will help you in tough battles.

title: Safe Merge
description: A simple idle merge game, you need to merge safes with same design to make a safe more powerfull, you need to unlock all design to win the game, the design are in the right, if the game was hard you can do prestige to win more money per cicle.

title: GoBattle.io
description: GoBattle.io is a multiplayer .io game in which you control a knight and battle against other players to become a king. Choose one of several available knights, including Batman and Vegeta!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Farm Match Seasons 3
description: With over 2700+ levels and a relaxing soundtrack to enjoy, Farm Match Seasons 3 is a charming Match 3 game that continues the story of the beautiful farm in the village. Your friend Poppy needs your help managing the farm — harvesting strawberries, collecting flowers, and protecting butterflies in the fields. Don’t forget to keep those pesky weeds under control! This sequel comes packed with a major content update and new challenges to discover.

title: Zombie Raft
description: Zombie Raft is a survival game. The zombie apocalypse is coming and it's time for a raft survival game! Protect yourself and other survivors from the looming zombie tsunami, and push them all back, it's your responsibility to survive on the raft! Squeeze the vehicles forward and push them if necessary! Keep going, escape the zombie tsunami, and conquer the barren land! If stranded survivors are found, you need to rescue them! Join us and experience the best zombie game!

title: Nuclear Day Survival
description:
Can you survive in a world where there was a nuclear explosion? There is radiation, hunger, disease and suffering around you. Your goal is to escape the dying city and find the love of your youth. A unique atmosphere and a heart-piercing plot. Uncover the mystery of the missing documents and make a choice: save the people around you or leave them to die..

Peculiarities:
— Crafting system
— Unique plot
— Exploring an interesting world

title: Bffs Cherry Blossom Celebration
description: Step into the vibrant world of BFFs Cherry Blossom Celebration, the ultimate dress-up game where best friends come together to shine under blooming cherry trees! Pick your favorite crew of BFFs and deck them out in stunning spring outfits—think pastel dresses, floral crowns, and cherry blossom vibes.

title: King Kong Kart Racing
description: Get ready for an exhilarating kart racing experience in King Kong Kart Racing, where you'll navigate thrilling tracks, outmaneuver opponents, and collect fuel packs to extend your runway, all while immersing yourself in a fun cartoon theme, complete with simple controls for both desktop and mobile users and a great racing soundtrack.

title: Gold Miner Classic
description: Jump into the most classic gold mining adventure ever! Gold Miner Classic brings you all the excitement of being a real gold miner. Feel into the perfect casual relaxation experience. Your mission is simple but incredibly satisfying.

title: Capybara Block Drop
description:
Capybara Block Drop is a fast-paced, brain-teasing puzzle game where merging numbers and staying calm under pressure is the key to survival.

Drop numbered blocks into columns, combine matching tiles, and clear space with big combos.
But watch out, if the board fills up, it’s game over, and your capybara buddy might just lose his cool!

With colorful visuals and satisfying number-merging mechanics, Capybara Block Drop delivers endless strategic fun wrapped in a charming, lighthearted package.

title: Street Style Fashion
description: Street Style Fashion is a dress-up game where creativity knows no bounds. Dive into the realm of trendy outfits and unlock endless style possibilities.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Battle Tanks Firestorm
description:
This game has incorporated the best of famous tank games. 
You can choose the tank that you like best, or prefer a more powerful version. Go to the levels and defend your base from the enemy. At your disposal are more than 15 types of tanks with various upgrades: armor, upgrades of the first, second and third levels. These improvements will help you gain an advantage over the enemy tank army.

title: Kick and Ride
description: Kick and Ride is a physics-based puzzle game consisting of two game modes. Drag and drop the block to make path for the soccer as well as for the vehicle. Enjoy the vibrant and colorful beach themed game.

title: Crazy Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 stunning supercars with crazy speed limits and drive them through 4 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in Crazy Traffic Racer!

title: Solitaire Summer: Klondike
description:
Ready to experience a summer full of Solitaire?
Finally, it's summer! Time to relax! What's better than to lay back, listen to the smooth tunes, enjoy the warm breeze coming from the sea and play some Klondike Solitaire.
Your goal in Solitaire Summer is simple, yet so addictive: Arrange all cards sorted by color in 4 stacks, from lowest to highest value. Can you remove all cards in the correct order and solve the Solitaire Summer puzzle?

title: Koi Fish Pond - Idle Merge Game
description:
An addictive idle merging game. Build your own Koi fish company and grow your business.
Release your Koi fishes into the pond and earn money every time they cross the finish line. Buy new Koi fishes (or collect them from the gift boxes), and merge the same level Koi fishes to upgrade into a new type. The higher-level of the Koi fishes, the more money you will earn. Use your earnings to buy upgrade packages in the Shop to help you make money faster!

title: Cowboys Duel
description: In this fast-paced cowboy showdown, players can either compete solo or engage in a thrilling duel against a friend, testing their reflexes and quick draw skills. Will you answer the call to become the fastest and most skilled cowboy around?

title: Transform Car Battle
description: you'll control a futuristic vehicle that can transform in an instant, speeding down tracks filled with obstacles and enemies. You'll need to swipe flexibly to dodge deadly lasers and traps while collecting energy cubes. At critical moments, tap the screen to transform into battle mode to smash through barriers, or switch forms to pass through special gates. Constantly challenge your reflexes, unlock more cool cars with unique transformation abilities, and set new running records!

title: Mahjong Match
description: Immerse yourself in our brain games, each level waiting for your mahjong match strategic touch. Your objective? Match three mahjongs of the same color to clear the board puzzle. With every  level presenting an array of mahjong tiles and brain games, the excitement of puzzle games will never wane.

title: Hexa puzzle
description:
Stretch your mind and train your brain with this addictive block puzzle game. Can you solve all of the hundreds of free puzzles?

Put your mind and brain to work to solve the puzzle game by placing the unique hexagon pieces neatly into the puzzle grid. Merge each hexo shaped piece into the grid one by one. Similar to Tetris, they all need to fit together to complete the puzzle. You may need more time to match all the blocks into the super perfect spot - but that's fine, there are no time limit!

title: Driverz Ed
description: Driverz Ed invites you into an open-world driving adventure where exploration meets discovery. Collect hidden puzzle pieces scattered across diverse locations, unlock a wide selection of cars, and complete missions that blend racing with strategy. With free exploration, fast travel, and mission tracking, the game delivers a fresh take on the driving genre while keeping every ride exciting and unpredictable.

title: Monster School vs Siren Head
High Heels 2
description: Stack rider new run adventure game with high heels, swipe to collect heels and make tall stack heels, and cross bricks and reach the destination. Have a good time.

title: Princesses of Quadrobics
description: Two beautiful princesses, Eliza and the Little Mermaid, are waiting for your help in creating the perfect images for practicing Quadrobics. First, create a gentle but expressive makeup for each of the girls and put your hair in a comfortable hairstyle. Then choose dresses, jewelry and accessories. But the adventures don't end there! Complete the look by putting masks in the form of adorable animals on the princesses. After all, this is a mandatory part of the Quadrobics trend!

title: NinjaRoof
description: NinjaRoof is a fast-paced and addictive arcade game where players control a nimble character jumping from rooftop to rooftop while avoiding deadly obstacles and aiming for the highest score. Test your timing, precision, and reflexes in this endless jumping adventure built with smooth physics and clean visuals.

title: Find It - Find The Differences
description: Find It is an engaging puzzle game that tests your observation skills as you search for subtle differences between two nearly identical images. With colorful visuals and beautifully designed scenes, each level presents a fresh challenge. Whether you're spotting tiny details or uncovering hidden objects, Find It will keep you entertained and focused. Hone your attention to detail, enjoy the excitement of finding every difference, and experience hours of fun suitable for all ages!

title: Mahjong Magic Islands
description:
The wonderful world of the Magic Islands is in desparate need of magic to help restore the waning natural beauty of their ancient cities with a new wild energy. Tons of mythical creatures await your help throughout these scattered island. You are their only hope to be saved, fix these wonderful magic lands back to their former beauty!

Mahjong: Tile Match features classic mahjong solitaire in a uniquely original visual format.

title: Shadow Stickman Fight
description: Shadow Stickman Fight is an awesome and intense 2D ninja survival arcade game. You have to survive the endless waves of enemies with stickman ninjas. Every time you pass a belt exam, you get the examiner’s hat and weapon. You can use souls to trade items or earn gifts. You have to follow the white dots and hit the enemies. You have to time your attack when enemies are in your attack distance. You can also enter the arsenal and choose different equipment, like helmets and weapons.

title: Fashion Makeover Dash
description: Ready for a fun fashion adventure? In Fashion Makeover Dash, you can run through the mall, collect cute outfits, stylish accessories, and shiny coins along the way! After the dash, it’s makeover time! Dress up your character with all the fashion items you collected and create the cutest look ever. You can also use coins to decorate your room and make it extra stylish. Run, collect, dress up, and have fun in the ultimate fashion makeover game!

title: 321 Choose the Different
description:
In this exciting casual puzzle game, you'll have less than 3 seconds to find the different figure among several options - the faster you find it, the more points you'll collect! 

Key features:

Fast Mode: Find the different figure in record time.
Relax Mode: Enjoy a calm and relaxing game, no pressure.
Extreme Mode: Test your skills with a real challenge.

321 Choose the Different is the perfect game to improve your observation skills and pass the time in a fun way.

title: Color Nuts
description:
Color Nuts is a relaxing and addictive color-matching puzzle game where you place colorful nuts on the board and connect three or more of the same color to clear them.

Plan your moves carefully, complete level objectives, and keep the board from filling up. Easy to learn and hard to master, Color Nuts is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of match-3, block puzzles, and logic games.

title: My Dreamy Flora Fashion Look
description: Welcome to My Dreamy Flora Fashion Look. Girls! You know that spring is on its way when you see the trees starting to bud and bloom, and the bulbs you planted last fall start to sprout out of the ground. Join with Ellie and their friends to celebrate the most beautiful and colorful season.

title: Exo Observation
description: Exo Observation is a space exploration incremental game where you uncover alien worlds and study mysterious lifeforms. You’ll collect resources, build advanced orbital science facilities, and manage them efficiently to progress. Each discovery pushes you closer to unlocking warp gates, letting you expand across the galaxy, and continue your quest for knowledge among distant stars.

title: Planet Merge
description:
Embark on an interstellar journey in the most thrilling puzzle game of 2025! Merge planets in a cosmic challenge and create a universe of fun.
imple Yet Addictive Gameplay: Just drag and release to align the planets. Watch as they combine into spectacular new celestial bodies.

title: Plane Chase
description:
Ever watched a plane soar across the blue sky and thought, 'Hey, I could catch that… in my car!'? Well, your oddly specific and gravity-defying dreams are about to come true in 'Plane Chase'!

Fasten your seatbelts, rev the engine, and remember: it's not car theft if you're aiming for the plane! Are you ready for takeoff in the wackiest chase ever? Download 'Plane Chase' and steer your way through this high-flying, tire-screeching adventure. The skies are literally not the limit!

title: Color 3D - Bump It Up
description:
The main principle is pretty simple – you are controlling a small ball that is always moving forward.

On your way, there are a few obstacles that you need to get through. There’s a small problem however, because you can only touch obstacles that are the same color as your ball. If you touch an obstacle with a different color, the game ends and you need to start from the beginning.

title: Ninja Crossword Challenge
description: It's time to test your vocabulary with Ninja Crossword Challenge, an educational puzzle online game for everyone, and a free game for kids to improve their vocabulary. All you have to do is fill in the words in the grid, the game has more vocabulary than you can imagine, ready to take on my challenge?

title: WordMix
description:
WordMix is a game where words hide their connections, and you uncover them.
The board is filled with word cards. Some of them share a theme, meaning, or association. Your task is to sense the link and bring the words of one group into a single row.
Sometimes the answer is obvious. Sometimes you have to think. And finding the right link feels great.
Play hundreds of levels and endless mode!

title: Hidden Objects Crime Scene
description:
Keep clear! It's a police crime scene, and the evidence must not be disturbed. Engage your detective instincts and dive into Hidden Objects Crime Scene!
 
Keep a sharp eye out for clues left behind by the perpetrator. Work fast, and you might solve the case!

Can you find all the pieces of evidence? Come play now, and let's find out!

title: Path ice
description:
Chill the soda, add some ice, but here's the problem, it's not so easy to get into the glass, you need to draw a path for the ice.

Draw the path as you like.
Go through many levels
Discover all kinds of ice and glasses

title: Street Ball Jam
description: Street Ball Jam is an entertaining one-touch basketball game to score as many balls as you can.  Release Date March 2017  Developer Street Ball Jam was made by Maksim Eliseenko.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Jump Man
description: A highly addictive endless jumper with a super cute but mischievous character! Chain combos and score as high as you can!

title: Overprotective Boyfriend
description: Imagine the beautiful Princess Marie standing in front of a mirror, looking at her reflection. Her eyes are shining, and a sly smile plays on her lips. She is ready to put on an outfit that will emphasize her grace and charm. But then her lover appears and frowns: «My dear, are you really going to wear such an open dress?» Marie knows that her faithful knight sometimes takes too much care of her, but today she intends to look dazzling!

title: Tile Hex World: Red vs Blue
description:
Build and destroy!
Take part in an exciting battle between Blue and Red! This time, you will have to extract resources, construct buildings and even build entire islands!
To ​​fight the enemy, you will need to build a path to his island.
Chop down trees, process resources into building hexes, with which you can expand your territory!
The winner is the one who captures the enemy flag and subjugates the enemy army!

title: Hand Over Hand
description: Embark on an exhilarating climbing adventure in "Hand Over Hand," the ultimate physics-based simulator game! Test your skills as you navigate through challenging levels filled with dynamic obstacles, strategic climbing mechanics, and thrilling ragdoll action. Race to the summit and grab the red flag, but beware of slippery surfaces and tricky terrain that will test your agility and determination.

title: Oil Digging
description: Oil Digging is a simulation game where you build and operate an oil rig. This game offers the experience of oil mining without the morning smell of oil! Dive into the world of oil drilling. Will your oil operation be a profitable masterpiece or an expensive mess? Start by finding an oil well, drilling it, and then building an efficient pipe system. Let's see if you can get rich!

title: Winter Wonderland Mahjong
description: Escape into a cozy Winter Wonderland filled with snowflakes, penguins, and festive cheer! Relax with calming music as you match beautifully crafted tiles in this soothing Mahjong puzzle game. Unlock charming new backgrounds and unique tile designs as you progress, each adding warmth and wonder to your journey. Perfect for unwinding, celebrating the holidays, and discovering the magic of winter—one match at a time.

title: Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon
description: Get spooky and stylish in Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon, where gothic meets glam in a 3-level makeover game. Treat Wednesday to a facial, apply stunning dark-themed makeup, and finish off with iconic dress-up fashion in her unique style. From skincare to eyeliner, you control every detail of her transformation. Whether you’re a fan of the Addams aesthetic or just love alternative beauty, this salon experience offers a complete glow-up from head to toe.

title: Vortex Ball
description: Roll through an ever-changing, vibrant tunnel filled with deadly obstacles and tricky hurdles. Test your reflexes as you dodge, weave, and survive as long as you can in this fast-paced infinite runner. Collect gems along the way and unlock 27 unique balls from the shop. With only 2 balls to start, every gem counts. The tunnel never ends, the colors keep shifting, and the challenge only gets harder. How far can you go? Compete for the highest score and prove your skills!

title: Wild Tanks
description:
Wild Tanks includes two game modes.
This is a survival race and tough tank battles.

Compete in tank races with shooting, earn stars, level up the tanker, upgrade your tank.
Take part in epic tank battles and destroy the enemy.

Break, destroy, destroy everything. Drive through the mountains, crush soldiers, blow up the enemy, have fun to the fullest!

title: Sprunki Challenge
description: Sprunki Challenge game adds a challenge mode to the famous Sprunki game and activates the game's battle mode. While the 1 Player mode of the game includes the classic mode, in the 2 Player mode you both make music using Sprunki characters and try to reach 2000 by generating scores. You can play the game with your friend in both dark mode and normal mode. If you want, you can also activate different backgrounds.

title: Bubble Shooter Free 3
description: Bubble Shooter Free 3 is back with a long-awaited 3rd sequel to one of the most popular bubble shooter games there is! This bubble shooter embraces endless gameplay that is designed for players to enjoy hours and hours of fun without time pressure. It boasts the ‘Bubble Swap’ feature which lets you swap the current bubble in your shooter with the incoming one as well as the BOMB which creates huge explosions popping 15 bubbles at once! Now the players can play even more strategically!

title: Superhero Phone Simulator
description: Explore action-packed mini-games, customize your hero, and test your skills in fun challenges. Whether you enjoy racing, creativity, or exciting adventures, this app has everything you need for endless fun!

title: Highschool Mean Girls 3
description: High School Mean Girls 3 is a fun beauty dress-up game that combines high school drama with glamorous fashion! Step into the world of competitive style as you transform two rival friend groups into showstopping fashion icons.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Hexa Blast Game Puzzle
description:
Hexa Blast Game Puzzle is a fun and challenging game! Try to find the right combination of hexa puzzle. Just drag and drop all the hexa block game on the board. The rule is simple: everything must fit! Enjoy the satisfaction of pieces fitting neatly in place.
Our unique hexagonal pieces will stretch your mind in ways you never imagined in this addictive hexa block puzzle game.
Keep your brain active and sharp, analyze all the possibilities and try to finish all puzzles.

title: Alien Chase - Swing and Fly
description: Alien Chase - Swing and Fly is the wildest swinging game in town! Play as a superhero on vacation, caught in the middle of an alien invasion. With nothing but your grappling skills, swing between towering skyscrapers and outrun the relentless alien swarm. It’s fast, it’s frantic, and it’s an endless escape—how far can you swing?

title: Farming Life
description: Start afresh in a small town with a tiny farm. Build it up and sell your goods on the local market. Become the most popular local farmer with the biggest and best farm around!

title: Block Parkour Trials
description: Block Parkour Trials is a super fun and free-to-play parkour game. Your goal is to reach the portal at the finish line by skillfully jumping over obstacles. Have fun and enjoy the challenge!

title: Starry Style Dorama of Dream
description: Welcome to an exciting journey into the world of Korean doramas heroes! Here you can become a stylist for two aspiring young film actors: a young actress whose heart beats to the rhythm of romantic stories, and a charismatic actor whose smile can melt even the coldest hearts. You will be able to choose from a variety of outfits, accessories and hairstyles, creating unique images that emphasize the individuality of your characters.

title: Extreme Makeover: Harley Edition
description: Extreme Makeover: Harley Edition is a beauty game to help Harley complete a makeover for her new date. Can you give her a fresh new look?
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: CS: Chaos Squad
description: CS: Chaos Squad is an exciting 5v5 team-based shooter that demands tactical thinking, teamwork, and quick reflexes. Engage in fast-paced battles where you can purchase weapons and gear each round, allowing you to adapt your strategy on the fly. The ranking system tracks player and team performance, encouraging continuous improvement and competition. Fight for victory, build team synergy, and prove that your squad is the best on the battlefield!

title: Bacteria: Life & Death
description: Bacteria: Life & Death is a chill, meditative growth game about a colony of microbes learning to survive. Feed them, warm them, and watch them multiply — or accidentally starve them, freeze them, or drown them in toxins. Every stage introduces a new twist: viruses, mutations, temperature swings, chemical spills. There is no rush and no timer. Just observe, adjust the environment, and discover what tips the balance.

title: Brainrot Ice Truck
description:
Step into the wild world of Brainrot Ice Cream, where over-the-top characters and ridiculous chaos blend perfectly with sweet, frozen treats!
Run your own ice cream truck, serving unhinged yet oddly charming customers with outrageous flavor combos, absurd toppings, and just the right amount of brain freeze.
Customize your setup, upgrade your gear, and keep up with the madness as each day gets weirder than the last.
Can you scoop fast enough to satisfy this wonderfully deranged crowd?

title: Auto Ninja
description:
Auto Ninja is the ultimate ninja platform game that dares you to conquer 41 trap-filled chambers with sharp reflexes and puzzle-solving skills. 

Your mission? Steal all three coins hidden in each chamber to unlock exclusive ninja skins and show off your mastery.

With simple but tight controls, dynamic level design, and a steady ramp in difficulty, Auto Ninja delivers an intense, addictive experience that tests your agility, timing, and wit. Play now and rise to the challenge!

title: Panda Kitchen Idle Tycoon
description: Want to become the best restaurant tycoon? You’ll build your own panda-themed food empire in Panda Kitchen: Idle Tycoon. Earn idle profits, and manage your way to success. Unlock new dining tables and kitchen equipment to improve efficiency. Recruiting chefs and servers to create an ultra-efficient restaurant team.

title: Happy ASMR Care
description: Happy ASMR Care is a fun cleaning simulator game. When life starts to get messy, its time to clean. This game offers you four modes of cleaning, including cleaning turtle barnacles, carpet cleaning, shaving, and hoof trimming. What do you prefer to clean? Come join us to start your cleaning journey!

title: Save my Hero
description:
Players may enjoy a unique gaming experience in Save my Hero Online, an engaging puzzle game that revolves on drawing lines. You take on the role of a superhero under assault from missiles in the game. It is your responsibility to create lines to stop these projectiles and shield the hero.

Finish every level and attempt to rescue the superheroes, such as Iron Man, Batman, Spider-Man, and so on.

title: Save Her Tour
description: This complex and relaxing puzzle game you've read about has finally become a reality! Only the smartest can pass these brain teaser quizzes and save the girl! Each level will give you a scenario where you must use your ingenuity to solve the problem. If you mess up, it won't end well for our heroine. There are so many different challenges waiting to be solved. This is the best puzzle game ever! Solve interesting puzzles, protect the girl from harm, and experience the thrill of success.

title: Hexa Stack Christmas
description: Get into the holiday spirit with Hexa Stack Christmas: a festive twist on the classic hexagon-stacking puzzle game. Place the Christmas-themed hexagon tiles stacks onto the board and sort the same color tiles to collect them. The game combines a light puzzle that requires attention and logic — perfect for relaxing while stimulating your brain. 2 game modes, infinite levels, a user-friendly interface, and save support let you play anytime without losing progress.

title: Ancient Wars: Caesar
description: Ancient Wars: Caesar is an exciting strategy game in which you lead an army and fight for supremacy on the battlefield. The game takes you to the world of epic battles where tactics, planning and proper utilization of resources are important. Control various units, including warriors, archers and generals, to destroy enemy troops and destroy their base.

title: Color Ring Sorting Match
description: Color Ring - Sorting Match is a vibrant and addictive sorting challenge that turns simple ring stacking into a clever strategic experience! Every move matters as you plan how to clear the board efficiently. This game delivers a perfect balance of fun and challenge. It’s a satisfying puzzle experience with a casual vibe, all centered around clever ring mechanics. Ideal for quick play sessions or longer brain-teasing moments!

title: Bubble Shooter Witch Tower 2
description: Bubble Shooter: Witch Tower 2 brings back the magic in a fun, family-friendly way! Pop colorful bubbles, unlock cozy enchanted rooms, and help the Witch Tower shine again. Meet adorable familiars, enjoy charming details, and celebrate the magic of every season — even a touch of Halloween spookiness! Easy to play for all ages, with plenty of bubble-shooting fun to enjoy anytime.

title: Xmas Hexa Sort
description:
Xmas Hexa Sort is a festive twist on the classic hexagon puzzle!
Move and place colorful stacks of blocks on the board to create perfect combinations and clear space. Relax, think ahead, and enjoy the cozy holiday atmosphere as you solve each cheerful puzzle!

title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
description: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online game takes the familiar lucky box idea and turns it into a more active risk-and-return loop. You move through 14 areas, open boxes, collect brainrots, and decide whether to head back safely or keep pushing for rarer finds. Online play is available through 1 Player mode, while local 2-player adds a same-screen option for faster, more chaotic sessions. Rebirth, speed upgrades, better boxes, base expansion, and roaming bosses keep every run moving forward.

title: Magic Sort
description:
Welcome to Magic Sort! — a relaxing and satisfying color-sorting puzzle with a cute cat café twist!
Your job is to organize colorful water layers inside multiple bottles. Each bottle contains mixed colors, and you must pour them carefully to sort every color correctly. Remember:
You can only pour when the top layers are the same color.
Once a bottle is perfectly sorted and filled with a single color, it magically transforms into a finished drink for your adorable cat customers!

title: Truck Simulator Arcade Championship
description: Truck Simulator Arcade Championship is an exhilarating truck racing game that combines the intensity of high-speed competition with the precision of driving massive, powerful trucks. This game offers an action-packed arcade-style experience where players take control of different types of trucks and compete in various challenging racing events across diverse tracks and terrains.

title: Flower Fairy Adventure Story
description: Welcome to Flower Fairy Adventure Story, a casual puzzle game that you can play for free. Flower Fairy lost her wings! Embark on an adventure where you solve each tiny jigsaw, dress up your girl in pretty clothes, and pave the way for the Flower Fairy. Practice your observation, logical thinking, and hands-on ability while enjoying the relaxing and captivating puzzle game.

title: Siberian Assault
description: Siberian Assault is an intense first-person shooter set deep in the unforgiving Siberian wilderness, where players are dropped into a hostile winter jungle brimming with enemy forces. As an elite operative, your mission is to survive relentless waves of enemies in this icy, snow-laden environment.

title: New Year's Eve Makeup
description: New Year's Eve Makeup is a beauty makeup game where you help three best friends dazzle for their big night. Craft Ellie’s cinnamon roll glam, Regina’s golden glow, and Kali’s icy gem look using a variety of makeup, accessories, and hairstyles.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Trucktopolis Cooking Chaos
description: Ready for some cooking chaos? Hop into your food truck and serve delicious meals across New York, Italy, and South Korea! Cook tasty dishes, serve customers before they lose patience, and keep the orders flowing. Complete daily goals, unlock new recipes, upgrade your kitchen, and keep customers happy before time runs out. Can you handle the rush and become a world famous chef?!

title: Lurkers.io
description: Lurkers.io is a multiplayer game featuring fast-paced action, resource gathering, and a fully destructible environment. Arm yourself with various weapons, build and destroy structures, and engage in competitive or cooperative gameplay across multiple modes.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Body Care Simulator
description: ASMR Cleaning is a fun simulation game on yad.com. There are four sections: foot spa, manicure, lip care, and clean inside the ear. You will enter a quiet and comfortable environment and experience different care processes. Have fun!

title: Offroad Muddy Trucks
description: Embark on a great adventure with huge trucks featuring massive tires and bodies in the Offroad Muddy Trucks game! You can play in either the 1 or 2 player career mode or explore a vast free map with a friend. The game offers surprises and entertaining terrain for you to discover. Let the monster truck simulator begin on muddy ground and experience all the various terrains on the map.

title: Cake Merge 2
description: Cake Merge 2 brings even more delicious puzzles with new cake combinations, and smarter challenges! Place cake plates onto the tray, combine matching slices into complete cakes, and clear the board before you run out of space. Enjoy new desserts, satisfying chain reactions, smooth animations, and relaxing gameplay. Whether you played the original or you're joining for the first time, Cake Merge 2 serves up an even sweeter merge experience!

title: Bone Doctor Shoulder Case
description: Oouch, our cheerleader took a tumble and hurt her shoulder. Help fix her up with a quick shoulder surgery by following the right steps to ensure she recovers fully. Once she healed, give her a make over with some stylish outfits and accessories from our collection, so she can return to the squad looking better than ever!

title: Push Push Cat
description: Push Push Cat is a puzzle game where you push and slide cats to rescue! Push the blocks and make a way to save the cute cats who have lost their homes.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Kawaii Friends: Tiles Matcher
description: Kawaii Friends: Tiles Matcher is a delightful puzzle game where you match adorable tiles featuring cute characters and vibrant colors. Your goal is to pair three identical tiles.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Speedrun platformer
description: A classic platformer with coin collection and jumping on monsters' heads. But if you complete the levels as quickly as possible, you can get into the leaderboard.

title: Bomber Battle Arena
description: Bomber Battle Arena is an exciting 3D collecting game that lets you play as a bomb-wielding character. Your goal is to strategically detonate bombs to clear various green plants and tree stumps, collect a golden key, and reach the treasure chest to advance to the next level. Be careful of the bomb’s blast radius and avoid contact with other monsters along the way. Get ready for an explosive adventure through 10 challenging levels full of explosive action!

title: Rootlings: Secrets of the Depths
description: Dive into Rootlings: Secrets of the Depths, an innovative turn-based game where you guide a root deep into the mysterious underworld. Collect water to survive, avoid hazards, and uncover surprises across exciting levels. Choose from Levels mode for challenges or Endless mode to climb the global leaderboard. Customize your root with stylish hats and enjoy minimalistic graphics and relaxing sounds in this unique underground adventure!

title: Archers Ragdoll Physics
description: Archers Ragdoll Physics is a physics-based archery action game where ragdoll characters fight using special arrows. The game features 10 characters and 12 unique arrows such as lightning, fire, poison, missile, and rocket. Players can equip three arrows and switch between them during battles. Some levels include traps like electric cables and spinning gears that can be activated with arrows. In 2 Player Mode, players choose from 7 arrows and compete to hit their opponent the most.

title: Bolts and nuts
description:
The game Bolts and Nuts is a logic puzzle? in which you have to unscrew bolts from planks?! Your task is to choose the right bolt to unscrew? so that you can unscrew all the planks ✌!
Compete with friends and colleagues ?!

title: Chicken Jump : A Tap Challenge
description: This is simple but addictive chicken jump game. You'll have lots of levels and you have to save your chicken but swiping on screen from bottom to up to make chicken jump so that it can avoid hurdles.

title: Rescue Hero
description: The hero begins his journey for treasure and save princess, but the puzzles in front of the hunter trapped him. What you need to do is to pull the pins in the right order, so that the hero can take the hidden treasure and save princess away from dragon, wolf and monster safely.

title: Horror Minecraft Partytime
description: Horror Minecraft Partytime is a spooky and interesting horror survival game. This time you will enter a familiar world of blocks. In this hide-and-seek mode, you will be the pursuer, looking for every corner. Find the weirdo in disguise and catch him.

title: Festival Vibes Makeup
description: Join Ellie in Festival Vibes Makeup, a vibrant game radiating the spirit of the summer festivals. Delight in creating neon, boho-Aztec, and grunge makeup looks as you test your makeup artist skills in this colorful makeup game for girls. Mix, match, and shine with stunning eyeshadows, mascaras, lipsticks, and glitter eyebrows!

title: Roller Coaster Rush
description:
Speed through tracks in Roller Coaster Rush! Play free and online in this thrilling coaster game.

Roller Coaster Rush is an exhilarating 3D game that puts you in control of a speeding roller coaster. Your goal is to accelerate through the tracks without crashing, performing crazy jumps and navigating steep drops. Hold to speed up and release to slow down just in time. Each level challenges your timing and precision as you rush through colorful and thrilling environments.

title: Just Ludo
description: Just Ludo is a tabletop dice board game. Roll the dice and let your chess pieces reach the finish line first, so as to defeat the opponent and win rich rewards. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Chill Girl Clicker
description: Chill Girl Clicker is a soothing, laid-back clicker game that’s perfect for unwinding and finding your zen. Just like its predecessor, Chill Girl Clicker, this game offers a serene and calming experience, but with a delightful twist: a charming girl as the main character, bringing a fresh and enchanting vibe to your screen.

title: Shark Chomp Chase
description: Play Shark Chomp Chase free online and jump into a fast-paced browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, making it perfect for quick breaks. Hunt, grow, and survive as you master each chase in a fun, skill-based challenge that feels like a light brain game. Mobile-friendly and built for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game that’s easy to start and hard to put down.

title: The White Room 5
description: The White Room 5 is the fifth sequel of an adventure escape game with a cartoon art style. Find objects that can help you escape the room and use your logic to solve the puzzles. Good luck!

title: Puzzle Fever
description: A vibrant new puzzle game featuring colorful hexagons! This straightforward yet engaging game offers a plethora of hues. Simply drag the blocks to navigate, fill the gameboard, and accumulate coins and points! Puzzle Fever caters to players of all skill levels, providing unique levels across various difficulties, from Basic to Master.

title: Nugget Man Survival Puzzle
description: Are you ready for adventure with the Nugget man character? To save the Nugget Man character who is stranded in the desert, you must fly into the sky without bursting the balloons. You must be careful to take the character to the finish by solving the puzzles before time runs out, accompanied by Gedagedago music. Rescue Nugget Man through desert bandits, cacti and many other challenging obstacles! Enjoy.

title: Kick Lucky Boxes Online
description: Kick Lucky Boxes Online is a fast-paced progression game where players launch lucky blocks across dangerous arenas to discover rare Brainrots and valuable rewards. Upgrade kick power, improve speed, and return safely before tsunamis flood the map. The game features online solo play with chat and room invites, local 2-player gameplay, character customization, rebirth progression, and more than 75 collectible Brainrots across 14 rarity classes.

title: Atlantic Sky Hunter Xtreme
description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey across the open Atlantic ocean in Atlantic Sky Hunter, an arcade endless shoot 'em up airplane game where you'll face off against challenging UFOs and formidable bosses, armed with an array of power-ups including spray bullets, extra health, and twin missiles; how high can you soar in this thrilling shmup adventure?

title: Falling Man
description:
Fall for fun in this addictive hypercasual game!
Ready for a wild ride? Join the thief as he falls from dizzying heights, dodging obstacles and collecting coins in this addictive hypercasual game. With two distinct locations to explore and endless possibilities for high scores, the fun never ends in this exciting game.

title: Ice Cream Sort
description: Sort delicious ice creams by moving them between shelves and match 3 identical treats to clear them. Reveal hidden desserts, plan your moves carefully, and solve hundreds of relaxing yet challenging sorting puzzles. Unlock exciting achievements as you progress, use the Shuffle booster to overcome tricky situations, and pause the timer by watching a rewarded ad and switch your preferred language anytime from the Settings menu.

title: Geometry Rush 4D
description: Geometry Rush 4D is an exhilarating 4D platformer that takes speed, precision, and reflexes to the next level. In this fast-paced, action-packed game, you guide a customizable character through vibrant, geometric worlds filled with intricate obstacles and dynamic traps. The game's signature dash mechanic allows players to perform rapid movements, weaving through ever-changing environments with seamless control.

title: Rocket Sky!
description: In Rocket Sky! you tap and hold the screen to launch your rocket as far into the sky as you can. Make sure not to overheat though, otherwise it’s game over!

title: Pyramidz2
description: PyramidZ 2 is, as the name suggests, the sequel to PyramidZ. It's a Match-3 game where you have to slide a row or column to align Egyptian symbols. This version is faster and allows for more combos.

title: Obby Modes! Online Mini-Games
description:
Is a massive online world where three unique modes are waiting for you!

Take on the challenge of 100 levels of hard obby, compete in crazy races with 5 players, and test your fate on a glass bridge in the spirit of Squid Game!

Create your unique character by choosing from over 100 cool skins!

Team up with friends using a code in squads of up to 3 people and conquer all modes together!

Ready to show off your agility and strategy? Set records and become a legend!

title: Stockings Dilemma
description: Stockings Dilemma is an interesting sorting game, in this game, you need to sort different stockings on a girl's leg. Sort them by colors and patterns, you'll find it's easy at first but becomes more and more difficult as the level rises. Can you complete the challenge? Have a try!

title: Dress Up Run
description: Play Dress Up Runway, the ultimate fashion dress up game where style meets speed! Collect outfits, change looks on the go, and shine in the final runway walk. Perfect for players searching “dress up game,” “fashion game,” or “makeover run,” this stylish challenge lets you become a fashion queen while racing through exciting levels. With princess vibes, outfit makeovers, and endless glam fun, Dress Up Runway is the best free fashion challenge for US teens and students!

title: Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake
description: Dive into a world of sweetness with Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake! Create a shimmering ocean-inspired jelly dessert using playful shapes and colors, then decorate it with sea-themed toppings for the perfect underwater delight.

title: Big Block Blast
description:
Place triangles and blocks to build 2x2 BIG BLOCKS! Drag and drop shapes into the grid to complete full squares made of triangles. Matching colors gives you bonus points, so in Big Block Blast you must aim for smart and colorful combos!
Some blocks have special powers and can even be placed on top of others. Use them strategically to unlock new moves and clear space. Big Block Blast is a simple to play game but tricky to master! How many BIG BLOCKS can you make?

title: Chinese Food Chef DuDu
description: Are you a fan of Chinese food? Do you want to discover the mystery of delicious Chinese cuisine? You do not want to miss this cooking game - Chinese Food Chef DuDu. Here, you have the chance to learn different recipes of traditional Chinese food, such as dumplings, rice dumplings, and zongzi. Win the heart of the little monkey with your delicious Chinese food!

title: Garden Tales Mahjong 2
description: Welcome to the second instalment of the popular Mahjong game that combines Solitaire Mahjong gameplay with the beautiful theme of the legendary Garden Tales match 3 game. Garden Tales Mahjong 2 features incredible 250+ puzzle layouts, 'Quick Play' mode for instant action, 'Chapters Mode' to unlock new puzzles. The more puzzles you complete the more puzzles you unlock. Enjoy this captivating journey and start your Garden Tales Mahjong adventure today!

title: Jewel Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Rebuild glorious castles in a magical Solitaire adventure! Conquer 200 levels, master 12 variants – from Klondike to Spider – and enjoy fresh mechanics that reinvent the classic. The kingdom’s fate lies in your cards – are you ready to play your way to glory?

title: War Lands
description: War Lands is an ARPG-style game with roguelike gameplay. Battle your way through a series of levels picking up buffs and loot, all while decimating hordes of enemies.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: What's The Difference?
description: What's The Difference? is a casual Spot the Difference game where you must find differences in two similar images.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Head Basketball
description: With exceptional shots, Head Basketball is a simple yet entertaining basketball game. The ball must be shot into the hoop of your opponent. Two points for each shot. It is imperative that you surpass your rivals in points before the time runs out.

title: Block Puzzle: Slide Block Jam
description:
Slide the blocks, beat the clock, and master the puzzle jam!

Block Puzzle Slide: Block Jam – Slide, Match, and Clear the Grid!

Get ready to train your brain in the most colorful way possible! In Block Puzzle Slide: Block Jam, your goal is simple but oh-so-addictive—slide the colorful blocks to their matching exits and clear the board before time runs out.

title: GTA: Grand Vegas Crime
description: Grand Vegas Crime is an open-world action game set in a sprawling city inspired by Las Vegas. Players take on the role of a daring gangster looking to rise through the criminal underworld. The game offers intense missions, thrilling car chases, and fierce shootouts against rival gangs and law enforcement. Grand Vegas Crime delivers an adrenaline-pumping experience filled with crime, action, and adventure.

title: Skate Hooligans
description: Help the little hooligans escape from the policeman who is constantly trying to catch them. Try to collect as many bonuses and coins as possible on the road, for which you can buy new coolest skateboards and amazing characters. And do not forget to complete funny tasks, because the number of points you receive depends on this!

title: Land Cruiser Offroad Driver
description: Take your cute dog along for a thrilling offroading adventure, and complete 4 awesome game modes across the city map with your awesome SUV. Customize and Upgrade it to your liking and ride in style across the giant offroading map. If you create nuisance in the city, the cops will be on your tail to chase you down. Drift the tires off the SUV and make as much money as you can. Are you ready for this thrilling adventure?

title: Meow Block: Color Collect!
description: A burst of color, clever thinking, and adorable cats await you in Meow Block: Color Collect! This charming puzzle experience turns simple movements into brain-teasing fun, where every swipe matters and every match brings you closer to victory.

title: Playground- Parkour
description: Jump and break bones, destroy enemies and unlock new levels! Ragdoll physics is what you need for parkour lovers. Train, participate in the battle and upgrade your hero! You will enjoy the game if you are a lover of the playground and stick games. Run, jump and maim the heroes. Ragdoll-style physics is what you love. Deals damage and unlock new levels! Stick and Ragdoll fans will be happy.

title: Tricky Arrow
description: Get ready to sharpen your skills in Tricky Arrow! Test your precision and reflexes as you shoot arrows at a spinning circle target. Aim for the bullseye and avoid hitting other arrows. With each twist and spin, the challenge grows, requiring strategy and accuracy. Simple yet addictive gameplay for all ages.

title: Flag Master: World Flags Quiz
description: Flag Master is the ultimate test of your flag knowledge and geography skills! Paint and recreate flags, solve jigsaw puzzles, guess capitals, match neighboring countries, and take on a variety of engaging challenges in a fun, fast-paced experience.

title: Syder Hyper Drive
description: Syder Hyper Drive is stunt car game, based on futuristic theme. Perform different stunts from varieties of available vehicles, complete missions in this endless game.

title: Fill Glass
description:
Fill Glass is a simple yet addictive game. Fill the glass to the perfect level without letting it overflow or fall short of the target. Precision is key as you pour, aiming for the highest highscore!
As you progress, upgrade your pouring machine to enhance your accuracy!

title: Bullet - Superhero
description:
Destroy your opponents in an exciting puzzle game! Become a superhero, shoot ricochets at enemies and win! A physical game with ragdoll-style heroes will help you improve your marksmanship skills and solve difficult missions!
A fun 2D game in which a superhero must destroy all his enemies.
It's not that simple, the hero's hand is constantly moving and you'll have to aim well to hit the target!
Shoot a ricochet at the enemy and complete all levels.

title: Pixel Path
description:
Pixel Path is a platformer with a non—standard plot.?
Get to the portal at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem... The floor may collapse, the spikes will move on you, and your character will grow to huge sizes. One wrong step and the game is over.❌
You will have to keep your sanity, expect surprises, show a good reaction and most importantly: do not get angry.?
The game also has a table of the best players who completed all levels faster than the rest.

title: Good Yard
description:
Welcome to Good Yard!
Grow flowers, sell them and upgrade your tools! Unlock new flowers and sell them for more! Can you fully upgrade your yard?

title: Real Car Parking And Stunt
description: Welcome to Real Car Parking And Stunt, a challenging driving simulation game. Here you’ll control a car and put your parking and stunt skills to the test. Choose stunt mode or parking mode, each level challenges you to park your car accurately while performing exciting stunts.

title: Xeno Defense Protocol
description: Xeno Online combines high-octane top-down shooting with strategic tower defense and deep RPG progression. Your mission is simple: Establish a base, defend it against endless waves of insectoid horrors, and extract with your life.

title: Hero Wizard: Save Your Girlfriend
description: One day when I woke up, I saw that my girlfriend wasn't beside me, so I started searching around for her but couldn't find her. Then I noticed a letter on the table, and the letter said: "If you want to see your girlfriend again, you'll have to pass through the magic forest to rescue her, but it won't be easy because you're not alone in the forest!" At first, I didn't understand, but..

title: Paradise Journey: Match3
description: Set sail on a tranquil journey across a breathtaking tropical archipelago. In this premium match- adventure, you are not just solving puzzles – you are restoring the vibrant soul of paradise itself. Follow a gentle narrative as you help a young traveler rediscover the forgotten beauty of the islands, one match at a time.

title: Shape Transform Race
description: Shape Transform Race is a fun racing game that can be played in reaction-based 1 and 2 player game modes. You can play the game against bots or against your friend. Always be the fastest by choosing the right vehicle for the terrain! You can unlock new vehicles and characters with the coins you earn from the races.

title: Piggy Clicker
description: Piggy Clicker is a classic Clicker game, where you get to have Piggy as your pet and trough clicking buy him toys and such

title: Beat Blader 3D
description: Immerse yourself in the ultimate rhythm experience with Beat Blader 3D, where music meets action! Slash your way through vibrant, futuristic landscapes in sync with the beat of your favorite songs. Armed with dual energy blades, you’ll slice through incoming obstacles, hitting targets in perfect harmony with the rhythm, all while dodging challenges that appear in time with the music.

title: Real Parkour Simulator
description: Real Parkour Simulator is an addictive 3D parkour adventure game. You play as an ambitious protagonist determined to conquer the world of parkour. Taking you on an exciting journey to new heights as you run, jump and climb in an immersive world. Will you rise to the challenge and become a parkour master?

title: Halloween Challenge
description: Get ready for a spooky adventure in Halloween Challenge! Bats are flying through the night, carrying candy that you must protect. Your mission? Tap the bats before they escape with the sweet treats. But beware, if even one bat escapes, the game is over! With simple controls and addictive gameplay, Halloween Challenge offers a fun and fast-paced experience for players. Test your reflexes, compete for high scores, and enjoy the eerie Halloween atmosphere. How long can you defend the candy?

title: Hazmob FPS
description: Hazmob FPS is an intense first-person shooter that blends tactical depth with fast-paced action. Players engage in strategic, team-based battles across diverse maps, utilizing customizable loadouts and a variety of game modes. With its dynamic gameplay mechanics, realistic graphics, and competitive ranked play, Hazmob FPS challenges players to master their skills, coordinate with teammates, and outwit opponents in a visually immersive and constantly evolving environment.

title: Bridge Wars
description: Gear up for Bridge Wars, a mobile gaming epic blending creativity and strategy. Immerse in a world where tactical mastery meets artistic flair. Draw patterns, summon stickman defenders in 3 seconds, facing relentless enemy vehicles. Upgrade characters, navigate intense environments, and stop foes from breaching. Embark on a thrilling adventure, showcasing tactical mastery against relentless waves!

title: Brainrot World Hole.io
description: Brainrot World Hole.io is a hilarious casual hole game packed with chaotic brainrot energy and funny Italian meme vibes. Control a growing hole and dive into a crazy world where swallowing everything in sight is the key to victory. Move around the map and collect objects smaller than your hole.

title: Math Box Balance
description: Math Box Balance is a puzzle game with numbers. Early levels have 2 boxes, and as you progress you can reach up to 8 boxes. Each box contains 4 number blocks, and the sum of these numbers is shown inside the box. Your goal is to make the sum of all boxes equal. You can swap number blocks between boxes to achieve the equal sum. It is an endless game where the difficulty increases over time, your score goes up, and the fun grows with it.

title: Coloring by Numbers. Pixel Rooms
description: Immerse yourself in a game where the process of coloring becomes truly meditative. Create and decorate houses as a designer. Just touch the screen and the colors will match the numbers in the image. Forget about boring routine - now you are thinking about color combinations. For even more relaxation, a music player has been added.

title: Match-3: Dream Room
description: Assemble the dream room and show your friends how to transform the space with clever combos! Join Match-3: Dream Room and create your dream room by solving puzzles and enjoying the exciting process of furnishing!

title: Connect the Dots - Color Lines
description:
Relax, focus, and enjoy a calming puzzle experience in Connect the Dots — a relaxing single-player brain game designed to help you unwind while gently challenging your mind.
Connect matching dots, create beautiful shapes, and complete colorful puzzles at your own pace. With simple controls, clean visuals, and stress-free gameplay, this game is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing puzzle games, brain teasers, and casual logic challenges.
Play now and enjoy a peaceful puzzle journey!

title: Vex X3M 3
description: VEX X3M 3 is here! The most intense Vex hill racing experience yet. Race through new levels filled with traps, sand, electricity, and unpredictable terrain that test your timing and skill. Ride through pipes, master new physics, and take on hard mode or a CPU opponent. Unlock powerful bikes, beat every track, and prove you’re a true VEX X3M rider. Start your engine and take on the challenge!

title: Hungry Corgi - Cute Music Game
description: Hungry Corgi is a music game where you feed the dog to music and try to catch the rhythm of the cutest songs created especially for this game. A perfect way to relax and have fun playing the cutest while also challenging rhythm game. Join to corgi adventure to meet new friends by opening characters, listen to fun songs and unlock incredible themes that change everything!

title: Hexa Block: Honey Cells
description: Dive into the exciting world of logic and shapes. Your task is to fill the field with multi-colored hexagonal blocks, choosing the right combinations. Each level is a new puzzle that requires attention, logic and precise calculation. Exciting gameplay, smooth animation and bright graphics make the gameplay as enjoyable as possible.

title: Nuwpy's Adventure
description:
Nuwpy’s Adventure is a classic pixel-art platformer inspired by retro arcade games!
Help Nuwpy explore colorful worlds, collect coins, jump over enemies, and avoid traps.
Each level offers new challenges, hidden secrets, and a fast-paced journey full of charm and nostalgia.
Dive into the pixel world and enjoy simple yet addictive gameplay!

title: Valentines Love Link
description: Valentines Love Link is a cute and relaxing matching puzzle game full of hearts, roses, chocolates, and love symbols. Connect matching Valentines items with straight lines, allowing up to two turns. Beat the clock across 48 levels by collecting all tiles and enjoy a sweet romantic theme.

title: The Shape
description: "The Shape" is an online geometrical puzzle game where players create figures based on given references. This fun, educational experience is suitable for all ages, featuring a seamless, gesture-based user interface.

title: Conquer.io
description: Expand your zone and assert your dominance over every territory on the map. Plan your moves to outmaneuver opponents and gain as much space as possible. But beware, your rivals will stop at nothing to thwart your plans. Are you ready to claim your space?

title: The Hardest Puzzle Ever
description:
An Exciting Puzzle Game for the Whole Family! ?

Play together and train your brain every day! ?? Enjoy thrilling puzzles suitable even for the youngest players. With new levels added daily, there's always a fresh challenge waiting for you!

Have fun, improve your skills, and become a true puzzle master! ??

title: Purrfect Puzzle
description: Purrfect Puzzle is an adorable cat-themed tile-merging puzzle game where players strategically place and combine cat tiles with different values to achieve higher scores. With relaxing pastel visuals, the game challenges players to think ahead while enjoying a cozy, heartwarming experience. Perfect for puzzle lovers and cat enthusiasts alike!

title: Poptropica
description:
Join millions of players in the adventures of Poptropica!
Complete unbelievable quests, written by Jeff Kinney, author of the Diary of a Wimpy Kid series!
Customize your character and adopt pets! Decorate your clubhouse and hang out with friends! There's so much to do in Poptropica!
And don't forget to collect prizes and compete with your friends - will you be the island champion?

title: Zombie Road
description:
In a world where the dead walk, the real challenge is getting smash them all with your car.
Even the apocalypse can’t stop the Zombie driver. Outfit your car with defenses, smash through the undead and reach the end.

title: Vex Try To Fly
description: Vex Try To Fly is a fast-paced launch adventure where your goal is simple: send Vex as far as possible! Blast out of a cannon, collect powerful boosts like jump potions, jetpacks, and portals, and use bounce platforms and wind to keep Vex in the air. Avoid dangerous obstacles, upgrade everything, and improve every run. Master the slam ability, fly farther than ever before, and discover how far Vex can go!

title: Grand Clash Arena
description:
Grand Clash Arena is a unique war game that offers an action-packed experience.

Key Features of the Game:

-Epic Combat Experience: Showcase your mastery against opponents by using every object at your disposal.

-Drop Weapons and Surprises: Alter the flow of the game with surprise drops from the sky. Surprise your opponents with powerful weapons that suddenly appear and gain an advantage.

Grand Clash Arena offers a unique gaming experience that combines the art of war and strategy.

title: Bubble Up
description:
Help BUB, a tiny bubble, fulfill its dream of reaching the blazing sun. Use his bubble friends, BLE, to push BUB past obstacles, rise from the ground to towering buildings, and conquer the skies!

You only need to shoot out BLE by click left mouse, good luck!

title: Merge Pixel
description:
Attractive characters in dot, pixel style!
Combining the same characters creates a higher level of characters.
Repeat Merge to create a legendary character.

title: Mate in Chess
description:
Solve clever chess-inspired puzzles with simple controls and satisfying logic. Think ahead, move pieces correctly, trap the king, and complete each level in the best possible way.
Every stage is a small brain teaser where one smart move can change everything. The rules are easy to understand, but each new puzzle becomes more interesting as you learn to plan combinations, avoid mistakes, and find the winning solution.

title: Association - Connect Word
description: Dive into the world of word puzzles and associations! In this game, you need to find hidden connections between words and group them logically. Each level offers new themes, new words, and increasingly challenging tasks. The game develops thinking, expands vocabulary, and trains attention. Intuition and logic will help you complete dozens of levels, from easy to hard, and become a true master of associations. Play at your own pace without time limits and use hints if needed.

title: Super Tank Hero
description: Super Tank Hero is an action shooting game. You can drive a tank to shoot and fight on the battlefield, usually facing seven enemies and obstacles. You need to collect soldiers before the battle, they'll join your team and help you fight. You can also find energy and Life on the battlefield to increase your speed or power. When you are able to fight, follow the instructions to find your opponent and fire at him until you beat him.

title: Echolocation Shooter
description:
Shoot to see in the dark!

Eliminate all the neon enemies, in the horroristic level!

The only way to see in this FPS is to generate soundwave with your weapon.

The goal is to keep merging and progressing to create new animals. Special buttons offer abilities like shaking the container or merging random animals, adding strategy and excitement to the gameplay.

title: Wheel in the face

Jump behind the wheel of a furious combat vehicle and rush into battle! Lightning-fast battles await you in closed arenas: ram enemies, dodge traps, use deadly weapons and win deadly fights.

Choose your style: cut your opponents with a sword, shoot them with a shotgun or burn them to the ground with a flamethrower!

Test your observation skills, take your time, and enjoy the satisfying thrill of discovering each well-hidden feline!

As nature’s last hope, your mission is to travel through beautiful landscapes, collect magical seeds, and revive the forest by planting trees.
