- Analysis after the game, highlights mistakes and gives recommendations on how to play
- Replay the game from the right place
- Setting the handicap

title: Sailor Chic vs Pirate Charm
description: Welcome to the trendy sea adventure! Two charming heroines are waiting for you in game: the humble little mermaid Amelie and the brave pirate princess Jacqueline. Amelie is the epitome of maritime glamour. Her style is white dresses, gold jewelry and wind in her hair. Jacqueline is the real pirate queen. She wears leather jackets, spectacular corsets and accessories with pirate symbols. Who will win in this fashionable battle - a sophisticated beauty or a daring sea robber? The choice is yours!

title: Merge Hospital
description:
Play as Doctor Player in Merge Hospital and discover the many secrets of your staff members, and what is happening in and around the Hospital. In Merge Hospital by Operate Now you will merge and build, meet and love many skilled surgeons, doctors and other interesting characters. You will learn more about their stories and how they got into the hospital.

As Dr. Player you must:
MERGE medical items, pies and much more!
DISCOVER the story of a medical drama like in your favorite TV shows.

title: Buckshot Roulette
description: Do you dare to bet your life on an exciting roulette wheel showdown? Buckshot Roulette is a gun simulator that combines strategy, shooting and survival. Instead of a pistol, a powerful shotgun was used. Every pull of the trigger is a choice of fate. The winner lives, the loser dies. You will begin a Turn-Based shooting roulette game. Each round will have a fixed number of bullets and blanks.

title: Dream Room Makeover
description: Welcome to Dream Room Makeover, part of the beloved Room Makeover game! You've just purchased a charming old house with a sprawling garden, but it's in need of some TLC. Get ready to renovate with stunning graphics and fresh furniture. Your dream home awaits – play Dream Room Makeover for free today!

title: Cannon Shooter
description: Cannon Shooter is an exciting arcade shooter where you can have endless shooting fun in fast-paced combat! You will control a cannonball firing hordes of heroic characters, facing many enemies. A quick click to launch more heroes and help you generate more heroes through the digital gate.

title: Evony The King's Return
description: Want to conquer the world? In Evony: The King's Return, step into a vast universe of war and zombie attacks. Command an army and use powerful weapons and guns to attack the enemy. Keep moving your soldiers, shoot digital doors, and expand your army! Keep shooting to get the gun. Face endless zombie waves with your shooting skills and unlock powerful weapons.

title: Urban Assault Force
description: Step into the boots of an elite counter-terrorism unit in Urban Assault Force, an intense first-person shooter that plunges you into the heart of urban warfare. The city is under siege by a ruthless terrorist group, and it's up to you and your team to strike back and save the day.

title: Capybara Suika
description:
Capybara Suika is a fun and relaxing food merge puzzle game starring adorable capybaras!
Inspired by the viral Suika Game, drop and merge food to grow bigger and score higher.
With colorful visuals, cozy vibes, and a tiny game size, it’s the perfect lite game to enjoy anytime!

title: Radical Rappelling
description:
Feel the rush and hold on tight as Radical Rappelling is back!

Join Rip and Roxy as you rappel down mountains at breakneck speed using your rapid reflexes.

Pull off death-defying tricks by ricocheting between launch pads, riding rainbows and rocketing over obstacles in the most redonkulous adventure ever.

Rack up coins and complete rockin’ missions to unlock sweet new gear for Rip and Roxy, the most fearless risk-takers on the planet.

title: С21A
description:
The endless card game "C21A" is an exciting combination of classic blackjack and addictive strategy. In this game, your goal is to collect cards to score 21 points. But be careful not to overdo it or you will lose! The game offers endless opportunities to develop and improve your skills.
The game "C21A" is a great way to pass your time and test your skills in card games.

title: Crazy Axe
description:
In Crazy Axe, you take control of a fearless warrior, armed with a powerful axe, to conquer a series of action-packed challenges. Swing your axe with precision, crush obstacles, and defeat waves of enemies. The game tests your reflexes and accuracy as you navigate through dangerous environments, dodging traps and outsmarting your foes. With each level, the difficulty ramps up, demanding quick thinking and faster reactions to survive.
Are you ready to take on the challenge and go axe-crazy?

title: Mushroom blocks
description: Meet colorful and diverse mushrooms! Collect mushroom blocks, earn points and win the rankings! On the way you will encounter all kinds of obstacles: lightning, bombs, frozen cells and others. Try to overcome all obstacles and hold out as long as possible, plunging into the cozy atmosphere of mushroom picking, accompanied by pleasant music!

title: Witch & Fairy BFF
description: Two unusual girlfriends - a Fairy and a Witch - study together, although they are so different. Fairy, with her delicate pink outfits and impeccable sense of style, is always ready to offer fashion tips and create vivid images. Her girlfriend-Witch, who prefers a Gothic style, chooses mysterious and gloomy outfits. Players will be able to help both heroines choose outfits for various events. Join magical friends in their exciting fashion adventure where style and magic go hand in hand!

title: Dynamons 8
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 8! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Chinese Festival world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Robocanyx, Jaxaguar, Sauryx, Dagaryx and Tydonyx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Fruit Cafe: Match 3
description:
Fruit Cafe: Match is a cozy meditative puzzle that blends the best of Mahjong and Match . Wind down after a long day to soothing music, match juicy fruit tiles and clear levels at your own pace.
Highlights:
• Over unique levels — from quick warm-ups to proper brainteasers
• boosters for any situation — they keep you out of dead ends or pull you out of one
• Adaptive difficulty — after a losing streak, the difficulty lowers by one level to match your pace

title: Dark Academia Wedding
description: Step into a world of moody elegance in Dark Academia Wedding! Help the bride and groom prepare for their enchanting, gothic-inspired celebration. Choose vintage dresses, romantic accessories, and rich color palettes that capture the essence of dark academia. From candlelit ceremonies to mysterious venues, every detail matters. Create the perfect blend of classic romance and intellectual charm in this stylish wedding dress up game!

title: Super Dog Hero Dash
description: Super Dog Hero Dash is an interesting 3D running game with endless adventure and fun! You’ll become a brave dog hero running through a colorful city in this cartoonish world. Begin exciting challenges across various platforms!

title: Cute Rabbit's Challenging Adventure
description: Accompany the cute rabbit's adventure together and have fun. I think it will be a little difficult to progress on the challenging tracks consisting of 5 sections in total. Avoid dangers and destroy enemies. Overcome obstacles and have fun times.

title: Gem Deep Digger
description: Dive deep into the underground world of Gem Deep Digger. In a fun and addictive simulation game,you dig, collect, and upgrade to uncover hidden treasures. With simple one-button controls, anyone can become the ultimate miner. Use your dig to carve through layers of dirt and rock, uncovering sparkling gems in the ground.

title: The specimen zero
description:
The moment has arrived to persevere in a hostile and mysterious environment. In the 3D horror game Specimen Zero, sick creatures creep across rooms, trying to murder you until you can find a way to escape.

You are terrified, you have no idea where you are, and your last memory is of being abducted. However, an unusual and maybe hazardous event has taken place in that peculiar location. A means of evasion from such establishments must be found by you.

title: GunFu Stickman 2
description:
Armed with a pistol in each hand, take control of the famous Stickman from the "Gun Fu" series and blast through hordes of enemies!

Reflexes and reaction times will be challenged and put to the test as the never-ending onslaught gets faster and faster!

Unlock more deadly guns and outfits, and customize your Stickman to suit your style!

title: Digworm.io
description: DigWorm.io is a fast-paced multiplayer arena where you guide a hungry worm tunneling underground in a race for food, energy, and dominance. Devour glowing orbs to grow, use boosts to outmaneuver rivals, and time your slows to recover health.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Block Pixels
description:
Block Pixels is a vibrant puzzle game where classic block-clearing action meets the creative joy of pixel art discovery.

Your main goal is to strategically place colorful pieces to clear lines on the board. But the real magic lies in what you clear. Each block you eliminate contributes to a larger masterpiece. Clearing specific colors helps you build and reveal dozens of charming hidden images, from cute animals to fun objects.

title: SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY
description:
SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY ??

OREN, a genius (but reckless) surgeon, must save PINKI after a brutal facial injury—without anesthesia! As more SPRUNKIS like TUNNER, shot in the head, flood the ER, OREN races against time. But lurking in the shadows is BLACK, ready to turn OREN’s mission into a nightmare. Will OREN save them all, or will BLACK end it in tragedy?

title: Pentaword
description: Guess the hidden five-letter word in just six tries! Use logic, spelling, and word skills in this brain teaser. Can you crack the Pentaword?

title: Z Stick Duel Fighting
description: Join the ultimate stickman battle in Z Stick Duel Fighting, a game that will make you fight for glory. You will play as a stickman warrior who must face other stickmen from across the universe. Can you win this duel competition? Various exciting and handsome skills are waiting for you to try! Calculate the amount of mana, avoid the enemy's attacks, and deliver a fatal blow! You are the stickman fighting king of the universe!

title: Downhill Car Ride: Crash Test
description:
Put on a real destructive show!

Forget about safety, in this game you need to check how strong the dummy is. At your disposal is a huge pile of dummies, an abandoned town, an incredibly huge arsenal and complete freedom of action! In this game you can check what will happen if you crash a motorcycle at full speed into a house with dynamite or what will happen if you jump out of the car a second before the accident!

title: Car Out Jam
description:
Car Parking. A puzzle game with cars and passengers.
Complete interesting levels with various mechanics!
The game will be interesting for both who want to relax leisurely and for those who like to unravel complex moves.
Easy levels are combined with more difficult ones. And some will be a real challenge for your brain!

title: Best Classic Freecell Solitaire
description: Welcome to FreeCell Solitaire! Dive into this classic card game where strategy and patience are key. With all cards visible from the start, plan your moves carefully to arrange them into the foundation piles by suit, from Ace to King. Use the free cells wisely to maneuver your way out of tight spots. Are you ready to tackle the challenge and clear the board? Play the Best Classic FreeCell Solitaire now and put your skills to the test!

title: Avatar World Secrets
description: Dive into various cute items, design the room setting, dress up your avatar family, and make up a life story as you like. Enjoy the fun interaction with items and characters online.

title: PuzzleJam
description:
Puzzle Jam is a bright and fun puzzle game where you merge jellies of the same color to clear the board and complete each level!
Easy controls and smooth gameplay make it accessible for players of all ages . Each level brings a new challenge – find the smartest moves, use boosters, and unlock powerful combos!

title: Split Shot: Ball Adventure
description: Drag the ball, set your direction, and navigate through a cosmic field! Collect all the stars while skillfully avoiding dangerous spikes. How many can you gather?

title: Phone Case DIY Run
description: Phone Case DIY Run is a very fun simulation game. What type of phone case do you have now? If you are interested in making a phone case, then come and join us to learn about the process! Collect the models, choose your favorite color for painting, then paste the picture and choose the pendant. Finally, the more phone cases you collect when you reach the end, the more money you get. Have fun!

title: Spider Bubu
description: Spider-Bubu swings from wall to wall across the city. Halloween has arrived, and you need to collect all the Halloween candies along with Spider-Bubu. Don’t forget to grab the giant pumpkin too! You must be very careful in the city — sharp spinning blades and pointed spikes are everywhere. Collect all the pumpkins and safely reach the portal that appears in the city.

title: K-Pop Hunter Fashion
description: Unleash your creativity in K-Pop Hunter Fashion, a unique dress up game where trendy K-Pop meets gothic demon hunter vibes. Style glamorous idols in bold K-Pop looks while blending them with dark, fantasy-inspired outfits. From leather jackets and spiked boots to neon hair, glowing makeup, and mystical accessories—you’ll create fierce, otherworldly fashion statements.

title: Zombie Terminator
description: Zombie Terminator is an exciting first-person shooter game where players take on the role of a survivor in a world overrun by a zombie outbreak. Players must survive and hunt zombies in this post-apocalyptic setting. The game attracts numerous players with its intense combat experience and rich weapon system.

title: Rope Stitch Puzzle
description:
CONNECT THE DOTS: Rope Stitch Puzzle Edition!

When life’s got you down and you’re feeling stressed out, what better way to make things right than to reach for your favorite cozy relaxing knitting puzzle and partake in a few puzzle solving game levels? 

Rope Stitch Puzzle is a satisfying ASMR game where you connect dots with rope to form colors and shapes that will come together and reveal a hidden puzzle.

title: Draw Weapon Fight Party
description: In Draw Weapon - Fight Party, you can draw your own weapons. Feel free to write your weapon, but keep an eye on the amount of ink left. Your creativity determines your combat style. Enter the 3D battle arena and fight against other opponents in an action-packed showdown. Draw precisely, craft the ultimate weapon, and crush your opponents to become the ultimate warrior.

title: Super Bitcoin Boy
description: “Super Bitcoin Boy” is a “Mario Bros” style platform game, themed around the Bitcoin cryptocurrency, eliminate enemies, overcome obstacles, collect all the bitcoins to get the highest score possible. Enjoy the Halving year, have fun playing and complete all levels.

title: Butterfly Sort Puzzle
description:
Various kinds of butterflies sitting on leaves.
Shy butterflies can only fly next to friends of the same kind.
Bring its friends to one leaf and fly them together~

title: Monsterella Fantasy Makeup
description: Step into the monstrous world of beauty with "Monsterella Fantasy Makeup". This spookily engaging game lets you work your makeover magic on three iconic cartoon characters. In Frankie's unit, electrify her look with eerie eyeshadows, neon lipstick, shockingly cool hairstyles, and otherworldly outfits. Next, embrace Clawdeen's earthy mystique with jewel-toned makeup and howl-inducing wardrobe choices. Finally, express Draculaura's vamp chic vibe with dramatic makeup and goth-glam ensembles.

title: Sid & Ginny Y2K Glam Clash
description: Welcome to the Y2K style fashion world! Two charismatic heroines are waiting for you, ready to try on fashion trends from the 2000s. Create spectacular makeup for them with lip gloss, shining shadows and glossy skin; choose stylish hairstyles - from smooth straight hair to playful ponytails and fashionable hairpins. Experiment with low-cut jeans, crop tops, mini skirts, shiny fabrics, and bold combinations. Complete the resulting image with iconic accessories of those years.

title: Zero to Millionaire!
description:
"Zero to Millionaire!" is an immersive life simulator where you rise from poverty to wealth! Start with simple jobs, earn your first money, and work your way up: open businesses, buy luxury houses, sports cars, stylish clothes, and build romantic relationships. Upgrade your skills, make life choices, and build a career or entrepreneurial empire. Live the life you’ve always dreamed of!
How far can you climb in Real Life?

title: Climb Up!
description: In this challenging adventure, you'll embark on a perilous ascent up a massive, treacherous mountain. Navigate slippery surfaces and unpredictable obstacles as you make your way towards the summit, where eternal glory and a rewarding gift await. Will you be able to overcome the many hurdles and reach the top, or will the climb prove too daunting? Your determination and skill will be tested as you brave the unknowns of this grueling climb.

title: Northern Lights - the secret of the forest
description:
A new hit for fans of the Match 3 game genre!

The Scientist Cat is already hiding items throughout the mysterious forest so you can enjoy finding things and earn as many emeralds as possible. The cat is happy to have new guests!
